content: I exited the calibrations, then went back in and started with load cell.  After going out and back in, it was less noisy and completed the test normally after a few more tries.  Not sure why the noise showed less after exiting and going back in.

What should we do if we consistiently get the error "loadcell data are noisy, make sure the printer is on a stable surface." It's on a marble countertop, I'm not sure what more stable of a surface I could hope for?
The QR code provided points to a guide that only seems to describe the screws to check on the nextruder, with little mention of INDX. It seems the only option is to contact support?

replies.content: I had this issue as well, but when guided by support, I found that you can click "ignore" on the message, and you will be able to complete the loadcell test. If the rest of the calibrations pass ok then there should not be an issue with the loadcell.
Same for me. Clicked ignore and then the test just started over and completed successfully on Firmware 8.0.0
